title: Wed 28 Oct 2026: Budget day, Fed decision tonight, FCA illiquid fund redemption rules, record ETF launches
summary: Wall Street rallies on Tuesday as oil eases, ahead of Chancellor John Healey's first Budget at half past twelve and the Federal Reserve decision at six this evening, with the ECB and Bank of Japan to follow. In regulation, a closer look at the FCA's proposed ninety day notice for illiquid funds, plus fresh transaction reporting and crypto consultations; in funds, Invesco's record assets, a record year for ETF launches and private credit gating, plus three COO action points and the week's diary.
